description: Source code for a H264 VAAPI video encoder delegate in Chromium, handling encoding parameters, SPS/PPS generation, and buffer submissions for hardware-accelerated H264 encoding on Linux/VAAPI.

classes.name: H264VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for hardware-accelerated H264 encoding using VAAPI, managing SPS/PPS, encoding parameters, and buffer submissions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder delegate with configuration, setting up sizes, profiles, levels, and packed headers support.

methods.name: GetCodedSize
methods.description: Returns the coded size of the video frames.

methods.name: GetMaxNumOfRefFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of reference frames.

methods.name: GetSVCLayerResolutions
methods.description: Returns the resolutions for scalable video coding layers.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an encode job, including H264-specific info.

methods.name: PrepareEncodeJob
methods.description: Prepares an encode job, setting frame types, reference lists, and submitting frame parameters.

methods.name: UpdateRates
methods.description: Updates encoding rates and SPS parameters based on new bitrate and framerate.

methods.name: UpdateSPS
methods.description: Generates and updates the SPS (Sequence Parameter Set) based on current configuration.

methods.name: UpdatePPS
methods.description: Generates and updates the PPS (Picture Parameter Set) based on current configuration.

methods.name: GeneratePackedSPS
methods.description: Creates a packed SPS header for stream embedding.

methods.name: GeneratePackedPPS
methods.description: Creates a packed PPS header for stream embedding.

methods.name: GeneratePackedSliceHeader
methods.description: Generates a packed slice header for stream embedding.

methods.name: SubmitFrameParameters
methods.description: Submits frame-specific encoding parameters to VAAPI.

methods.name: SubmitPackedHeaders
methods.description: Submits SPS and PPS packed headers to VAAPI.
